items.title: Putting Earth AI to work: Geospatial agents for our planet's biggest challenges
items.summary: Shravya Shetty, Distinguished Engineer, and Luke Barrington, Product Director, Google Research In a new technical report, we demonstrate how combining domain-specific foundation models, spatial tools, and upfront planning enables a Geospatial Reasoning agent to carry out complex spatial analysis and planetary prediction that standalone LLMs can’t.

items.title: "Pairing Geospatial Data with Homegrown AI"... Wavus, Upstage Target Public-Sector AI Market
items.summary: Upstage Head of Public Sector Business Lee Jaeyong (left) and Wavus CEO Park Changhun (right) pose for a commemorative photo after signing an MOU for joint research and cooperation on AI agents on the 8th.

items.title: First Principles First: Need to Calibrate Data Access for Disaster Resilience
items.summary: Every year on October 13, the United Nations marks the International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction, a date the General Assembly fixed in 2009 after first setting aside a day for natural disaster reduction in 1989.

items.title: Good Governance Needs a Strong Code of Conduct
items.summary: Editorial: Most geographers work for government agencies or do substantial business with them, so how those agencies are governed is our business too.

items.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
items.summary: With ia. i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

items.title: RTX Spark Ignites Global Celebration as New Windows PCs Arrive
items.summary: NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are now available, bringing NVIDIA Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory and the full NVIDIA AI platform to slim, premium Windows PCs.

items.title: Anthropic’s AI Safety Bill Has an Alarming Threshold for Government Action
items.summary: CEO of Anthropic Dario Amodei looks on as U.S. President Donald Trump holds a press briefing with AI executives on September 29, 2026.

items.title: California Gov Newsom boosts AI regulation as he eyes 2028 presidential run
items.summary: San Francisco, United States – In his last few executive orders signed as California governor, Gavin Newsom, whose final term ends in January, issued one asking for independent verification of artificial intelligence models and set up an expert committee to create kill switches for AI agents that could go rogue and cause harm.

items.title: Can AI be regulated? Why experts say government intervention is needed — but could be tricky
items.summary: As concerns mount over incidents of AI agents going rogue, experts and stakeholders are increasingly pushing for government regulation of AI systems that are becoming more capable.

items.summary: Bill Gates plans to widen his push on AI safety, Axios reported, citing unnamed sources.
